summary: Verified all 6 bug fixes (KPI truncation, calendar year clipping, easy delete for cancelled bookings, ₹₹ double-symbol, partial balance collection, editable hall name in invoice). Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass — including 3 new tests for the new PATCH /api/auth/me endpoint (401 without bearer, 401 with bad token, correct pydantic schema shape). GET /api/auth/me and POST /api/auth/session User schema now include hallName (Optional[str]) per code inspection. Frontend static code checks: theme.ts formatINR no longer prefixes ₹ and exports formatINRFull + formatINRCompact; BookingDetailSheet.tsx uses formatINRFull() consistently (grep for backtick+₹+dollar-brace formatINR returned 0 matches) and includes testIDs header-delete-btn, collect-amount-input, collect-confirm-btn, preset-0.25/0.5/1; dashboard.tsx uses formatINRCompact for KPI values and imports SettingsBottomSheet; calendar.tsx month/year container has minWidth:140 with textAlign:center; SettingsBottomSheet.tsx exists and default-exported. Frontend web preview loads login page with 'Continue with Google' button (no red screen, no runtime errors). End-to-end tap flow for KPI/delete/collect/settings not exercised because all these screens are Google-OAuth-gated (per test_credentials.md — no test password credentials, real Google account required).
action_items: Owner (main agent) should manually log in with a real Google account and verify (a) Dashboard 3 KPIs display without truncation and use compact form like ₹3.5L, (b) Calendar header shows '2026' fully, (c) BookingDetailSheet header trash icon deletes ANY booking (not just cancelled/completed) after confirm, (d) Payment Summary shows single ₹ (no ₹₹), (e) Collect Payment modal accepts a partial amount and increments advancePaid by the entered amount (not overwrites), (f) SettingsBottomSheet saves hallName via PATCH /api/auth/me and the shared PDF invoice header uses the saved hall name.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py User model correctly adds Optional[str] hallName and PATCH /api/auth/me is auth-gated via get_current_user; UserUpdate uses payload.dict() with None-filtering — safe.
server.py L151: exchange_session returns hallName only for existing users; new signups return hallName=None which is correct (they'll set it later via Settings).
BookingDetailSheet.tsx L77-79: submitCollect validates amt<=balance and calls onUpdate({advancePaid: advance + amt}) — correctly ADDS instead of overwriting. Good.
BookingDetailSheet.tsx L135-137: header-delete-btn is unconditional (always shown regardless of status), addressing 'easy delete for cancelled bookings' plus more.
theme.ts formatINRCompact: uses .toFixed(n % X === 0 ? 0 : 1) — correctly hides '.0' for round numbers (e.g. ₹3L not ₹3.0L). Nice.
calendar.tsx: month container minWidth:140 with textAlign:center guarantees room for a 4-digit year like '2026'.
SettingsBottomSheet.tsx L43: save button is disabled while busy OR name is empty — prevents blank hall names being saved.

AuthContext / api.ts wiring for updateHallName and hallName prop drilling into BookingDetailSheet → shareInvoice were referenced in problem statement — file contents look consistent with static grep, but full runtime path needs a real login to exercise.

success_rate.frontend: Static code checks 100%; login screen renders; auth-gated screens not exercised (Google OAuth required)
